Add or remove a tab from the server

Source: R/el_tabs.R
insert_el_tab.Rd

Element's addable and editable tabs leave adding to the app: clicking "+" reports input$<id>_tab_add, and the app decides what the new tab holds. These are how, in the manner of shiny::insertTab() and shiny::removeTab(). The content may hold any UI, this package's components included.

Usage

insert_el_tab(
  session = shiny::getDefaultReactiveDomain(),
  id,
  name,
  label,
  content = NULL,
  closable = NULL,
  select = TRUE
)

remove_el_tab(session = shiny::getDefaultReactiveDomain(), id, name)

Arguments

session

Shiny session; the current one by default, as for shiny::updateTextInput().

id

Tabs ID (un-namespaced).

name, label

The new tab's name and label.

content

The new tab's content.

closable

Whether it can be closed. NULL follows the tabs' own setting.

select

Whether to switch to it. Default TRUE.

Value

Called for its side effect; returns NULL invisibly.

Examples

if (interactive()) {
  library(shiny)
  ui <- el_page(el_tabs("docs", editable = TRUE, tabs = list(
    list(name = "t1", label = "Tab 1", content = tags$p("First"))
  )))
  server <- function(input, output, session) {
    n <- 1
    observeEvent(input$docs_tab_add, {
      n <<- n + 1
      insert_el_tab(session, "docs", name = paste0("t", n),
                    label = paste("Tab", n), content = tags$p("New"))
    })
  }
  shinyApp(ui, server)
}
